chunks: Abu Sulayman Ahmad ibn Hawtha al-Bahili narrated, saying: Ibrahim ibn Ishaq narrated to us, saying: Abdullah ibn Hammad al-Ansari narrated to us, from Abu Baseer, saying: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) narrated to us and said: A caller will call out the name of the Qa'im, 'O so-and-so son of so-and-so, get up!'

key_terms.الْقَائِمِ: The Riser / The Imam who rises to establish justice
key_terms.فُلَانُ: So-and-so (a placeholder for a specific name)
key_terms.يُنَادَى: He is called out / A caller announces

ai.seo_question: What is the sign of the heavenly caller announcing the name of al-Qa'im?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, this hadith from Abu Abdillah (al-Sadiq) via Abu Basir describes the 'Nida' (heavenly call) where the Mahdi is summoned by name and lineage, serving as a definitive public proclamation of his identity. This event marks the transition from occultation to active leadership, emphasizing divine selection and the immediate recognition of the Imam by the heavens before the people.
